- Cardiomegaly is explicitly mentioned as present or stable in multiple reports, including findings of an enlarged cardiac silhouette.
- Lung opacities and densities are identified, with one case noting an asymmetric apical opacity and another mentioning densities compatible with scarring.
- Atelectasis is noted as a chronic subsegmental finding in the left base of one patient.
- Lung lesions are represented by findings of calcified granulomas and lymphadenopathy, although some reports specifically exclude nodules or masses.
- Pleural effusions and pneumothorax are consistently denied across all relevant clinical findings.
- No fractures are reported, and skeletal structures such as the ribs are described as intact where mentioned.
